articles.summary: Credit: Jerry Hildenbrand / Android Authority TL;DR Google Wallet’s new stacked card design is facing criticism from users now that it’s rolling out more widely. A major complaint is that multiple cards from the same bank can look identical because the stacked view doesn’t show identifying details such as the last four digits. Some users also say switching between their most-used cards now requires more actions than with the old horizontal carousel. Google Wallet’s new card redesign is reaching more users, but the wider rollout has exposed a pretty annoying usability problem.
